package_info.package_versions: 2019.4 HF 5 (and others during the attack window)
package_info.why_malicious: The package was compromised to include a malicious backdoor (SUNBURST) that enabled remote code execution and data exfiltration, despite being code-signed and distributed as an official update.

execution_context.file_location: SolarWinds.Orion.Core.BusinessLayer.dll (injected into the main application binary)

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code checks for network connectivity and anti-analysis conditions, then beacons to a remote C2 server, receives commands, executes them, and exfiltrates data.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code establishes covert communication with an external server, receives and executes remote commands, and exfiltrates sensitive data, all of which are hallmarks of a backdoor.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal update DLLs should not initiate outbound network connections to unknown domains or execute arbitrary code from remote sources.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Telemetry or update check-ins may contact vendor servers, but should not execute arbitrary remote commands or exfiltrate internal data.

attack_chain.action: Malicious code is injected into the SolarWinds.Orion.Core.BusinessLayer.dll and code-signed as part of an official update.
Customers install the signed update, loading the malicious DLL into their Orion platform.
attack_chain.leads_to: Malicious code executes in trusted environments

attack_chain.action: At runtime, the backdoor code activates, establishes covert C2 communications, and awaits attacker instructions.
attack_chain.leads_to: Remote command execution and data exfiltration

behavioral_signatures: Unexpected outbound network connections from SolarWinds Orion processes
DLLs with code sections not present in legitimate versions
Runtime checks for anti-analysis or sandbox evasion
Execution of arbitrary commands received from external servers
file_indicators: Presence of code-signed DLLs with unknown or suspicious code sections
network_indicators: Connections to known SUNBURST C2 domains (e.g., avsvmcloud.com)
Beaconing patterns from Orion servers to external IPs/domains
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for unexpected outbound network activity from SolarWinds Orion processes, verify the integrity and hash of Orion DLLs against known-good versions, and inspect for code sections that implement C2 communication or remote command execution. Alert on code-signed updates that introduce new network behaviors or anti-analysis logic.
